content:
If you missed yesterday’s “Surprise and Shine” event and don’t feel like watching the entire hour-plus-long video, Apple’s YouTube Channel has got you covered. Watch the event recap below.

Apple shares short event recap

In addition to the iPhone Duo, Apple’s first foldable iPhone, Apple also unveiled the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max yesterday, alongside the Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4, and the AirPods 5 with Active Noise Cancellation.

The event was just a few minutes shy of 1 hour and 20 minutes long, and featured Apple’s trademark mix of executives talking to the camera in between marketing demos and product ads.

For those who don’t have that kind of spare time on their hands, Apple also published a fun short recap of the event, in which a narrator skips backward and forward through the video as she summarizes the main points of each announcement.

Apple also shared separate videos featuring what is basically the full segment for each product announcement, all of which you can watch below.
